Correspondingly, Raghu Bharvad - with a long wooden shepherd's staff in hand - was present as Swamishri came for the darshan of Harikrishna Maharaj. Swamishri (continued): In Gadhada, Shriji Maharaj had made a magnificent gateway to the mandir. Once, a shepherd like you was passing by and saw the gate. 'Oh! What a grand gate!' he marveled.
